key_insight: Fourier-circuit configuration affects LiDAR classification accuracy and noise sensitivity: IQFT-After performs best on ideal KITTI simulations but degrades more under quantum noise.
engineering_relevance: Hardware-aware circuit selection matters, and removing final QFT SWAP gates reduces complexity while preserving Pauli-Z features up to a permutation absorbable by the classifier.
method: Combine PointNet feature extraction, amplitude encoding, and a variational quantum circuit.
Compare No-QFT, Full-QFT-After, QFT-no-swap, IQFT-After, and Trainable-QFT.
Evaluate classification, class-level behavior, circuit complexity, and simulated noise robustness.
evidence_signal: Tests on KITTI, nuScenes, and PandaSet across three seeds yielded ideal KITTI weighted F1 of 0.857 ± 0.033 for IQFT-After versus 0.838 ± 0.023 for No-QFT; IBM FakeManilaV2 noise changed the circuit ranking.
watch_item: Noise-model simulations do not establish real-hardware performance, and minority-class behavior varies by dataset.
paper_title: QFT-Based Hybrid PointNet-Quantum Neural Networks for LiDAR Point-Cloud Classification
